# form.openDialog

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Open a dialog.

```lua
form.openDialog(title, message, buttons, options, wakeup, paint, closeWhenClickOutside)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes | the title of the dialog |
| `message` | string | yes | the message of the dialog |
| `buttons` | table | yes | the table of buttons, each button is a table with these keys: |

Fields of `buttons`:

- 'label' (string): the displayed text
- 'action' (function): the function which will be called on button press

| `options` | number | yes | text flags like TEXT_LEFT, TEXT_CENTERED, etc. |
| `wakeup` | function | yes | handler called at each loop |
| `paint` | function | yes | paint function |
| `closeWhenClickOutside` | bool | yes | close the dialog when clicking outside |

## Returns

Dialog

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local buttons = {
  {label="OK", action=function() return true end},
  {label="Cancel", action=function() return true end},
  {label="Nothing", action=function() return false end},
}
local dialog = form.openDialog({
    title="Dialog demo",
    message="This is a demo to show how to use LUA Message Dialog",
    width=500,
    buttons=buttons,
    options=TEXT_LEFT,
    wakeup=function()
      print("dialog wakeup ...")
    end,
    paint=function()
      lcd.drawText(10, 10, "Text overlay!")
    end,
    closeWhenClickOutside=true
})
```
